40 weeks + 7 days = 40 × 7 + 7 = 287 days.  
1153 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 1153-03-11 add 287 days:  
March: 31 - 11 = 20 days left → 287 - 20 = 267 left.  
April: 30 → 237 left. May: 31 → 206 left. June: 30 → 176 left. July: 31 → 145 left. August: 31 → 114 left. September: 30 → 84 left. October: 31 → 53 left. November: 30 → 23 left. December: 31 → 23 - 31 = -8 → means date is in December: December 31 - 8 = December 23, 1153.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1153-12-23
